comment: Named UI test suites (tools/test_suites.py). Selectors: Class, Class/method, globs, plan:NAME, map:KEY, suite:NAME; exclude subtracts. 'plan': true marks a suite for an .xctestplan. Run: tools/ios_uitest.sh --suite NAME. Docs: .agents/testing/apple/suites.md
